responsibility: Provides the main GCC OS configuration for FreeBSD targets by wiring the shared FBSD_* spec layer into standard GCC target macros. It sets FreeBSD CPP, start/endfile, library, and linker-eh specs; selects libc-function knowledge and early sanitizer library linking behavior; declares ELF object format and basic system type definitions; and enables common OS facilities such as POSIX I/O. This is the direct target-configuration header, whereas freebsd-spec.h is the reusable shared-spec component beneath it.
same_name_distinction: Within the FreeBSD same-name pair, this header supplies the OS configuration macros, spec wiring, and libc/linking policy, while freebsd.opt merely declares the FreeBSD-specific driver option names consumed by those specs.
